yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:

  title: Syndicated Credit Agreement
  description: Syndicated Credit Agreement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_syndicated_credit_agreement_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/syndicated_credit_agreement
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/syndicated_credit_agreement
    sourceVersion: fs_syndicated_credit_agreement_v1
    sourceDigest: 4f2d03c3e7b8ec31f66fb38ad058f5e5a5b16b532f1f5e4ed27174f300c26b7b
spec:
  documentType: syndicated_credit_agreement
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - agreement-date
        - maturity-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - facility-type
        - financial-covenants
        - governing-law
        - negative-covenants
        - pricing-grid
        - tranches
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - assignment-minimum-amount
        - benchmark-rate
        - commitment-fee
        - mandatory-prepayment-events
        - total-commitment-amount
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - administrative-agent-name
        - borrower-name
        - guarantor-names
        - lead-arranger-names
        - lender-names
        - required-lender-threshold
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - collateral-summary
  fields:
    - id: agreement-date
      name: agreement_date
      label: Agreement Date
      description: Date of credit agreement or amendment.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/agreement_date
    - id: borrower-name
      name: borrower_name
      label: Borrower Name
      description: Borrower legal name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/borrower_name
    - id: administrative-agent-name
      name: administrative_agent_name
      label: Administrative Agent Name
      description: Administrative agent or collateral agent.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/administrative_agent_name
    - id: lead-arranger-names
      name: lead_arranger_names
      label: Lead Arranger Names
      description: Lead arrangers, bookrunners, or private credit sponsors.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/lead_arranger_names
    - id: lender-names
      name: lender_names
      label: Lender Names
      description: Named lenders or lender groups.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/lender_names
    - id: facility-type
      name: facility_type
      label: Facility Type
      description: Revolver, term loan A, term loan B, delayed draw, unitranche, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/facility_type
    - id: total-commitment-amount
      name: total_commitment_amount
      label: Total Commitment Amount
      description: Total commitments across all tranches.
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/total_commitment_amount
    - id: tranches
      name: tranches
      label: Tranches
      description: Tranche entries with name, amount, maturity, pricing, and currency when present.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/tranches
    - id: maturity-date
      name: maturity_date
      label: Maturity Date
      description: Final maturity date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/maturity_date
    - id: pricing-grid
      name: pricing_grid
      label: Pricing Grid
      description: Pricing grid or spread mechanics.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/pricing_grid
    - id: benchmark-rate
      name: benchmark_rate
      label: Benchmark Rate
      description: SOFR, base rate, prime, EURIBOR, or other benchmark.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/benchmark_rate
    - id: commitment-fee
      name: commitment_fee
      label: Commitment Fee
      description: Unused commitment fee percentage if stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/commitment_fee
    - id: collateral-summary
      name: collateral_summary
      label: Collateral Summary
      description: Collateral or security package summary.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_summary
    - id: guarantor-names
      name: guarantor_names
      label: Guarantor Names
      description: Guarantors or loan parties.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/guarantor_names
    - id: financial-covenants
      name: financial_covenants
      label: Financial Covenants
      description: Financial covenants.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/financial_covenants
    - id: negative-covenants
      name: negative_covenants
      label: Negative Covenants
      description: Negative covenants.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/negative_covenants
    - id: mandatory-prepayment-events
      name: mandatory_prepayment_events
      label: Mandatory Prepayment Events
      description: Asset sale, debt issuance, excess cash flow, or other prepayment triggers.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/mandatory_prepayment_events
    - id: assignment-minimum-amount
      name: assignment_minimum_amount
      label: Assignment Minimum Amount
      description: Minimum assignment amount if stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/assignment_minimum_amount
    - id: required-lender-threshold
      name: required_lender_threshold
      label: Required Lender Threshold
      description: Required lender voting threshold.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/required_lender_threshold
    - id: governing-law
      name: governing_law
      label: Governing Law
      description: Governing law jurisdiction.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/governing_law
  validationRules:
    - id: borrower-name-present
      severity: error
      description: borrower_name is required for Syndicated Credit Agreement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: borrower_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: borrower_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: borrower_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(borrower_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: administrative-agent-name-present
      severity: error
      description: administrative_agent_name is required for Syndicated Credit Agreement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: administrative_agent_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: administrative_agent_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: administrative_agent_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(administrative_agent_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-commitment-amount-present
      severity: error
      description: total_commitment_amount is required for Syndicated Credit Agreement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: total_commitment_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: total_commitment_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_commitment_amount IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(total_commitment_amount)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-commitment-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: total_commitment_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: total_commitment_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: total_commitment_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_commitment_amount IS NULL OR total_commitment_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: commitment-fee-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: commitment_fee should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: commitment_fee
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: commitment_fee
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: commitment_fee IS NULL OR commitment_fee >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: assignment-minimum-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: assignment_minimum_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: assignment_minimum_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: assignment_minimum_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: assignment_minimum_amount IS NULL OR assignment_minimum_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      borrower_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Syndicated Credit Agreement workflow.
      administrative_agent_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Syndicated Credit Agreement workflow.
      total_commitment_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Syndicated Credit Agreement workflow.
      tranches:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Syndicated Credit Agreement workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Syndicated Credit Agreement documents combine structured fields and narrative risk/legal/compliance
      context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      agreement_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of credit agreement or amendment.
        format: date
      borrower_name:
        type: string
        description: Borrower legal name.
      administrative_agent_name:
        type: string
        description: Administrative agent or collateral agent.
      lead_arranger_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Lead arrangers, bookrunners, or private credit sponsors.
      lender_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Named lenders or lender groups.
      facility_type:
        type: string
        description: Revolver, term loan A, term loan B, delayed draw, unitranche, or other.
      total_commitment_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total commitments across all tranches.
      tranches:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            tranche_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for tranches item.
            tranche_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for tranches item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Tranche entries with name, amount, maturity, pricing, and currency when present.
      maturity_date:
        type: date
        description: Final maturity date.
        format: date
      pricing_grid:
        type: string
        description: Pricing grid or spread mechanics.
      benchmark_rate:
        type: string
        description: SOFR, base rate, prime, EURIBOR, or other benchmark.
      commitment_fee:
        type: number
        description: Unused commitment fee percentage if stated.
      collateral_summary:
        type: string
        description: Collateral or security package summary.
      guarantor_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Guarantors or loan parties.
      financial_covenants:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Financial covenants.
      negative_covenants:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Negative covenants.
      mandatory_prepayment_events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Asset sale, debt issuance, excess cash flow, or other prepayment triggers.
      assignment_minimum_amount:
        type: number
        description: Minimum assignment amount if stated.
      required_lender_threshold:
        type: string
        description: Required lender voting threshold.
      governing_law:
        type: string
        description: Governing law jurisdiction.
    required:
      - borrower_name
      - administrative_agent_name
      - total_commitment_amount
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: commercial_lending
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - borrower_name
          - administrative_agent_name
          - total_commitment_amount
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - tranches
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
